 Show HN: Programmatic (and self-updating) SaaS demo videos ( rundown.video ) 
 1 point by guico 6 months ago | hide | past | favorite 
 Hey guys! While building another SaaS we got fed up with recording and, re-recording demos for help-center so decided to try and automate it using Playwright. Turns out it's not that easy, but we got it to a point that's usable, and quite useful for us already. Feel free to try and send feedback. Every new account gets some free credits so you can see what it can do. Thanks! PS: Because this is heavy on infra we have a waitlist thing but I'm monitoring and will let you in within minutes/hours, just need to space people out a bit. Thanks PPS: Here's an example video made with Rundown https://www.rundown.video/011fb9da-72f7-41d1-bdce-f187f398e0...
